recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit the retraction-reason sentence only after FHIR-56192 or another applied/published decision adds DiagnosticReport.statusReason or Observation.statusReason to current source, because that later change may provide a computable location for the reason that FHIR-8668 currently leaves in narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-8668 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DiagnosticReport correction from DSTU1. It requested replacing outdated guidance that retracted every result value using the Special Values concept "withdrawn" with guidance to retract the DiagnosticReport and associated Observations by replacing status codes with "entered-in-error", updating conclusion/comment and narrative text, and optionally providing a retraction reason in narrative.
initial_application: The correction was applied in commit bf1bfec2132fcdc4c84463588a1d681cb644d001, whose subject explicitly says "QA Diagnostic Report including technical correction #8668". That commit changed source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-notes.xml from the Special Values/withdrawn guidance to the entered-in-error wording. A later editorial commit, 72be4e488cad4031ab41edce39f3ffb1fa0bf83c, preserved the rule while adjusting punctuation and adjacent status prose.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-notes.xml is in the current build scope. The current DiagnosticReport notes contain the requested sentence, DiagnosticReport.status is bound to a value set whose code system includes entered-in-error, and Observation.status also includes entered-in-error. FHIR-56192 later requests statusReason on Observation and DiagnosticReport, but it is only Resolved - change required/Ready_to_Apply and no current DiagnosticReport.statusReason element exists.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative DiagnosticReport source and supporting status definitions already satisfy the published FHIR-8668 correction.
